notes.title: Update 1.4. Customer voiceover! Disks with games! Improved graphics! Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hey resellers! 😃

We just updated our game to version 1.4.
In this update we:
- Added customers voiceover. Now - customers will tell you that something is cheap or expensive. Maybe they wanted a specific product but you don`t have it in your store. Or maybe they found item they searched! 🗣️
- We added a new product category - cd disks with games! Now - you can sell "Tech Store Simulator" while you`re playing in "Tech Store Simulator" ♾️
- We improved our graphics. Now - the game should have better light, better shadows and overall should look better on every graphics tier!👾
- We fixed critical bug when on powerful PC - the time in the game runs faster than on a weak PC.⏱️
- We fixed a bug when - if you start a new game - some suppliers that you bought in the past - are already bought in new game.🤨

Also we fixed a lot of minor bugs! We hope that you will enjoy new update. 🙌

Thanks for your support and have a good game!

P.S:👻BOOO🎃

notes.title: Store schedule update
notes.content:
Hey resellers!

In this update we added "store schedule" system.
Now - our store will automatically close at 11 PM. When the time comes - you should manually start a new day by press [b][Enter][/b] button (of course after you serve all your current customers.

When you will start a new day - you will receive a detailed summary of previous day. 
How much clients you had, how much money you spent, how much you earned and other data.

With this info you will know if your store is profitable or not)

Also - from now we will save not only your store data but also the time of day when you leave the game last time so when you will enter in the game next time - you will start right where you end last time!

Thanks for support and have a good game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.14
notes.content:
Hey resellers!

In this update we added a thief system. Now - a dangerous look guy can enter in your shop and try to steal something.
How to fight against this? Well - you have a magic button on your keyboard [[b]T[/b]], if you hit [[b]T[/b]] you will make a leg kick.

Also - we added a new employee that will fight against thief. Now - you can hire not only stockers and cashiers, but a security too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088760/ec88d5f7a5c5190438d353ec2d7ffe3848c8dd6f.png[/img]
Try the update by yourself and be careful they don't steal your whole store!

Have a good day!

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.content:
Hey resellers!

In this update we added some new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088760/71ac342d45131a4cd1a69555756317c20f9178f9.jpg[/img]
First of all - we added new money-generating feature. Now - you can buy arcade machines, put them in your store and sometimes, your customers will play in them and generate some additional cash.
We added 3 different arcade machines available at different progressions.
The other big change is that we've completely changed the look of the initial store. Now it is lighter and more beautiful!
Also - we added new decoration items.

Finally, we've expanded our warehouse capabilities.
Now - you will be able to expand the storage to 11 shelves, each shelf can hold 12 boxes. Thus - you will be able to store absolutely all items (and even more) that are available for sale in your store!
